subject: Acceptance window stewardship and escalation request
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Lund <sofie@medinova.com>, procurement@medinova.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:42:00 +0100
Subject: Acceptance window stewardship and escalation request

Hi Sofie / Medinova procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. I wanted to surface a short stewardship note: based on the outstanding SOC2 evidence request and your procurement queue timing, our original acceptance window (go-live target 2028-06-10) is at risk. Attached is MAP_v2.pdf (redline of the mutual action plan) and the draft SOW for reference.

What we need from you this week:
- Confirmation of procurement milestone ownership (who will sign the order form and by what date).
- If SOC2 evidence will require a PO-level review, please flag the procurement contact and anticipated earliest sign date.
- Any internal blackout dates that could block integration testing (we have a 2-week test window).

If procurement cannot commit to the current cadence, I propose we re-baseline to preserve quality and avoid a rushed cutover. Can you confirm whether we can lock a revised MAP by 2028-05-25?

Im looping in Ben for exec alignment and Priyom for the rebaseline risk log.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+44 20 5555 0199

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf (redline), SOW-Redwood-Medinova-v1.docx
From: Sofie Lund <sofie@medinova.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Janet Morel <janet.morel@medinova.com>, procurement@medinova.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:15:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Acceptance window stewardship and escalation request

Hi Stephanie,

Appreciate the heads-up and the updated MAP. Short answers: procurement is queue-constrained this quarter and Janet (cc) will own the PO sign-off. Janet — procurement will need the finalized SOW and a short procurement_matrix.xlsx that maps milestones to required artifacts. Ive attached a quick matrix that shows where we see gaps (SOC2 evidence and legal redlines).

SOC2: Our security team has requested a scoped evidence package to approve data handling. Thats the most likely cause of a 1–3 week review delay depending on the artifacts you can provide this week.

We can target a revised MAP but need the rebaseline proposal and risk log to formalize it. I can confirm an internal procurement signoff by 2028-06-01 if we provide the final SOW and the evidence bundle by 2028-05-28.

Sofie
Head of Digital Product, Medinova Health
sofie@medinova.com

Attachment: procurement_matrix.xlsx

Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 14:08:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: Acceptance window stewardship and escalation request — proposed rebaseline

Team — forwarding Medinova's response. Key ask: they can sign procurement by 2028-06-01 if we provide final SOW + evidence by 2028-05-28. Risks I see and proposed mitigations below (Ive attached a working risk log):

1) SOC2 evidence lag — risk: 1–3 week review. Mitigation: deliver evidence bundle by 2028-05-24; schedule security Q&A with Medinova on 2028-05-26.
2) Procurement queue — risk: PO sign moves to 2028-06-01. Mitigation: we issue an amendment with clear milestone acceptance criteria (DocuSign link in MAP cover).
3) Integration test failures (unknown edge-cases) — risk: potential cutover rollback. Mitigation: extend acceptance window by two weeks, freeze feature changes during test window.

Recommend we propose a formal rebaseline: move go-live from 2028-06-10 to 2028-06-24, keep a 2-week acceptance window and lock the rollback plan. I need Ben to confirm exec touchpoint cadence (theyre asking for a decisional owner).

Please review the attached slippage_risk_log_steph.xlsx and advise by EOD Thursday 2028-05-24 so I can share the formal MAP update with Medinova on Friday.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Attachment: slippage_risk_log_steph.xlsx

Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 09:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acceptance window stewardship and escalation request — proposed rebaseline

Good summary, Steph. I can take the exec sync. Proposed plan:
- Exec touchpoint (30 min) Monday 2028-05-26 15:00 BST — confirm rebaseline and approval authority.
- Approve the two-week shift to 2028-06-24 as long as SOC2 evidence flow is confirmed and the DocuSign amendment is initiated.

Ill be explicit on what I need from Priyom (final risk log summary) and Kimberly (legal sign-off on the amendment language). If Janet/Medinova confirm procurement countersign by 2028-06-01, we should be comfortable with the shift and reduce the chance of a rushed cutover.

Ben

ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Revised MAP and formal rebaseline proposal (action required)

Hi Sofie / Janet,

Per our internal review and Ben's exec alignment, attached is the formal MAP update and an amendment cover that documents the rebaseline. Summary:
- Original go-live: 2028-06-10
- Proposed rebaseline go-live: 2028-06-24
- Acceptance window: 2 weeks (2028-06-24 to 2028-07-08)
- Required deliverables from Redwood by 2028-05-28: final SOW, evidence bundle (SOC2 artifacts), updated test plan.

Escalation path: if procurement sign-off slips beyond 2028-06-01 we will execute a staged cutover contingency (documented in section 4 of the MAP). We prefer to avoid staged rollouts but will proceed if procurement cannot meet the amended milestone.

Action items for Medinova this week:
1) Confirm procurement owner and target sign date (reply-all).
2) Confirm security point-of-contact for the SOC2 QA session on 2028-05-26 10:00 CEST.
3) If you can countersign the DocuSign amendment by 2028-06-01, please do so (link below).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/recipient/sign/abc123
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890

I will mark this as a formal escalation request to preserve traceability — Ben, can you join the 2028-05-26 security/Q&A and exec sync?

Thanks,
Stephanie
